meta.description: The forced-choice counts of the one-shot referential game: the word a speaker chose for each target, and the object a listener chose in the salience condition and on hearing each ambiguous word. A context has a square and a circle of one colour and a circle of the other; colours and positions were counterbalanced, and the tables name the objects as in the paper's sample context.

types.name: Object
types.doc: The three objects of a context, named as in the paper's sample context.

levels.name: greenSquare
levels.label: green square
levels.doc: the object with the unique shape

levels.name: greenCircle
levels.label: green circle
levels.doc: the object that shares both its features

levels.name: blueCircle
levels.label: blue circle
levels.doc: the object with the unique colour

types.name: Message
types.doc: The four words a speaker could be offered.

levels.name: salience
levels.label: Salience
levels.doc: the utterance is in a language the listener does not understand

levels.name: green
levels.label: Green
levels.doc: the listener hears the shared colour

levels.name: circle
levels.label: Circle
levels.doc: the listener hears the shared shape

tables.name: speakerChoice
tables.doc: the number of speakers who chose a word for a target, of 144 per target.

columns.name: target
columns.doc: The object the speaker refers to.

columns.name: count
columns.doc: The number of speakers who chose the word, with `none` where the word was not offered.

tables.name: listenerChoice
tables.doc: the number of listeners who chose an object in a condition, of 240 in the salience condition and 180 in each of the others.

columns.name: count
columns.doc: The number of listeners who chose the object.
